services.name: 3-Hour Kayak Rental
services.desc: The waters surrounding Sarasota are a paradise that deserves to be explored, not from afar, but from up close. A kayak tour through Sarasota Bay and the Lido Key mangrove tunnels are the best way to explore this paradise. Why a Sarasota kayak tour? Simple: Our kayak tours put you in the middle of the awe inspiring beauty of these waters. The Lido Key mangrove tunnels are a hidden gem that needs to be experienced to be believed. The green canopy reflecting off of the crystal clear water can only be accessed with a small vessel such as a kayak. services.desc: Kayaking in Sarasota. It’s what we live & breathe and one of our passions is being able to share that love with the community around us. Sarasota is full of activity and people who love the gorgeous water as much as we do! On April 22nd 2017, Swim Without Limits held their annual Swim Around Lido Race. For the 3rd year in a row, Paradise Adventures Sarasota has been a kayak sponsor for this event. Getting out on the water with all of these brave athletes is such a joy for us. Have you heard of this Sarasota event before? We love being part of such an awesome experience! Watching the swimmers try something this crazy is inspiring!
